verdict.rationale: Pipedream runs an official remote MCP server that any external MCP client can point at. It exposes 10,000+ pre-built actions across 3,000+ connected apps as callable tools, with auth handled automatically. That clearly covers the "connected app actions" branch of the story. missing for 10: evidence that custom user-built workflows can be exposed as MCP tools, detail on configuring or selecting which tools are exposed, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent tool calls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can expose my workflows or connected app actions as MCP tools that an external agent can call

citations.quote: Add Pipedream MCP to your app or agent to make tool calls on behalf of your users to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools.
Point any MCP client at Pipedream's remote server ... Your agent picks the tool — auth is already handled
This is handled automatically by Pipedream's MCP server and there's no additional implementation required
Pipedream Connect provides managed auth, MCP servers, and API tooling for 3,223
